objective: Factor frozen REL_INC into residual/column incidence topology and progressively finer frontier-relative delay labels to identify the smallest topology-aware quadratic coordinate that preserves scalar exactness.
motivation: EW-RS-040 shows simple scalar component parities are insufficient on 4x4-k4 and 6x3-k3 even under exact-rank grading.
EW-RS-036 shows REL_INC is scalar-exact on all demanding carriers.
Therefore the missing information lies in internal residual/column incidence topology and its correlation with gravity delay.
descriptor_ladder: TOPO: canonical residual/column hypergraph, delay erased
TOPO_D0: topology plus frontier/not-frontier bit per residual cell
TOPO_DPAR: topology plus delay parity per residual cell
TOPO_D012: topology plus delay bucket 0,1,>=2 per residual cell
REL_INC_EXACT: topology plus exact relative delay per residual cell
anti_circularity: Every topology/delay descriptor is declared before outcome qualification.
Descriptors depend only on current RFG residual incidence and gravity depth.
No W/D/L label selects a topology feature or delay bucket.
falsifiers: Any scalar contradiction rejects that descriptor on that carrier.
REL_INC_EXACT must agree with the established REL_INC scalar result; disagreement invalidates the harness.
A descriptor may be scalar-exact without spanning the full structural quadratic space; those claims remain separate.
next_if_success: Freeze the coarsest descriptor scalar-exact on all demanding carriers, then derive the two syndrome coefficients in that coordinate and qualify them on a fresh non-affine holdout.
next_if_fail: Retain exact REL_INC and search for a compact topology invariant only inside the fitted pair-support classes; do not reintroduce absolute board height.
